title: 横移大把手
description: 粉彩描绘离垫很近的横向大点路线，身体平衡而放松。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: An original soft-pastel illustration depicts a fully clothed fictional adult traversing sideways across a low bouldering wall rather than climbing upward. Oversized peach jug holds follow a shallow horizontal arc, with broad footholds just above the continuous crash mat. The climber transfers weight toward the right foot while the left hand remains securely on its previous hold. Show the whole body in a side-on medium-wide composition, with generous empty wall space ahead and a tidy landing zone below. Use dusty coral, lavender, and warm gray pigment. Make the movement gentle and anatomically plausible, with no dyno, lettering, spectators beneath, or logos.
